dates_and_calendars.add_periods

Retrieves the updated date, based on the provided start date and particular period of time or calendar values.

Available as lseg.data.dates_and_calendars.add_periods.

add_periods(
    start_date: OptDateTime = None,
    period: str = None,
    calendars: list[str] | None = None,
    currencies: list[str] | None = None,
    date_moving_convention: DateMovingConvention | str | None = None,
    end_of_month_convention: EndOfMonthConvention | str | None = None,
) -> datetime64

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
start_date OptDateTime No None Start date of calculation.
period str No None Calculation time period.
calendars list[str] | None No None Calendars to determine the working days and national holidays for particular countries. Optional if currencies is provided.
currencies list[str] | None No None Currencies to use for calculation of the date for the working day or weekend. Optional if calendars is provided.
date_moving_convention DateMovingConvention | str | None No None Convention for adjusting the dates.
end_of_month_convention EndOfMonthConvention | str | None No None Possible values for the end of month.

Returns

np.datetime64

Added period date

Example

import datetime
import lseg.data as ld
from lseg.data import dates_and_calendars

ld.open_session("platform.default")

added_period = ld.dates_and_calendars.add_periods(
   start_date=datetime.date(2014, 1, 1),
   period="1Y",
   calendars=["BAR", "KOR"],
   date_moving_convention=dates_and_calendars.DateMovingConvention.NEXT_BUSINESS_DAY,
   end_of_month_convention=dates_and_calendars.EndOfMonthConvention.LAST28
)

Related types

DateMovingConvention

The method to adjust dates. The possible values are:

Name Value Description
DateMovingConvention.BBSW_MODIFIED_FOLLOWING 'BbswModifiedFollowing' Adjusts dates according to the BBSW Modified Following convention.
DateMovingConvention.EVERY_THIRD_WEDNESDAY 'EveryThirdWednesday' dates are adjusted to the next every third Wednesday.
DateMovingConvention.MODIFIED_FOLLOWING 'ModifiedFollowing' Adjusts dates according to the Modified Following convention - next business day unless it goes to the next month, preceding is used in that case.
DateMovingConvention.NEXT_BUSINESS_DAY 'NextBusinessDay' move to following date when public holiday.
DateMovingConvention.NO_MOVING 'NoMoving' no moving convention.
DateMovingConvention.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY 'PreviousBusinessDay' move to preceding date when public holiday.

EndOfMonthConvention

End of month convention. The possible values are:

  • Last,
  • Same,
  • Last28,
  • Same28
Name Value Description
EndOfMonthConvention.LAST 'Last'
EndOfMonthConvention.LAST28 'Last28'
EndOfMonthConvention.SAME 'Same'
EndOfMonthConvention.SAME28 'Same28'
